value.rationale: The spherical harmonic gradient is a canonical quadratic Sobolev energy density. The theorem completely classifies its all-dimension real L4 norm, both sharp normalized fourth moments, every maximizing/minimizing eigenvalue pattern, the low-dimensional Hilbertian cutoff, exact parity-dependent Euclidean Banach--Mazur distance, and spectral deficit identities. These natural structural properties are not a routine recalculation of a pre-existing scalar L4 theorem or an arbitrary finite slice.
